newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka closes weaker on dlr demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka closes weaker on dlr demand.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed weaker at 43.2975/2990 to the dollar in interbank trading on Thursday against the previous close at 43.2960/2990, dealers said.
The local unit opened at 43.2980/2995 per dollar but edged up slightly by the close.
Dealers said demand from two large nationalised banks helped the U.S. currency gain.
Call money was traded at 5.5 to 6.5 percent, slightly up from the previous 5.0-6.0 percent, dealers said. Bank transactions in Bangladesh close by midday on Thursday.
